scope: full product catalog extraction and click-eligible pool separation

rules.public_products: retain every unique non-empty parent_asin across all categories; preserve missing values as JSON null
rules.duplicate_resolution: keep the most complete normalized row for an exact product_id duplicate
rules.click_pool: title and category present; price 1..10000; average_rating 1..5; rating_count >= 5

click_product_pool.scope: internal generator input; excluded from tier byte totals and S3 Source uploads

projected_1gb.projection_basis: products use measured bytes; remaining bytes preserve the measured v1 users:click_events byte ratio
projected_1gb.note: actual output may exceed the target slightly to keep complete JSONL rows and complete per-user event bundles
